# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-03T23:43Z · next run ~05:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-04T13:43Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 26 measured from open data, 4 follow a published figure, 59 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 41/100 (Strained) · 18 Alert · 39 Watch · 32 Normal Headline: The US–Iran war keeps Hormuz largely shut after Iran called the US reply 'not convincing' on 3 Nov. A Russian strike on a Zaporizhzhia aid point killed 33, and the Ebola outbreak has passed 5,300 deaths.
## Situations (9 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: US struck Qeshm Island on 2 Nov; Iran called the US reply 'not convincing' on 3 Nov. Record 30 ship attacks in October; Brent near $104. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, oil, eu-gas, fertiliser, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, worsening]: Toll from 2 Nov strike on a Zaporizhzhia aid point rose to 33; Russia fired 289 drones and 76 missiles overnight into 3 Nov. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.2: drought in Australia and East Africa, record warmth and weaker carbon sinks. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: Africa CDC counts 5,376 Ebola deaths and 10,444 cases to 2 Nov across DR Congo, Uganda and Kenya; a WHO emergency (PHEIC) since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Sudan says drones killed 484 civilians from February to 27 Oct, with 97 drones used in October; no talks under way. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - Cyclone Murasu [ALERT, improving]: Murasu crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast near Ongole early on 3 Nov and is weakening inland; 10,000 evacuated, no deaths reported. → alert: other-cyclones - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread 160bp on 2 Nov; 410,000 marched on 31 Oct and unions call a general strike for 5 Nov. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US CPI 4.0%; Australia hiked to 4.85% on 3 Nov and a Bank of England rise is expected on 5 Nov. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility; normal: em-stress - Record Binance hack attributed to North Korea [WATCH, stable]: FBI says North Korea stole about $6.3bn from Binance; Pyongyang denied it on 3 Nov. Bitcoin ETFs saw $399m outflows on 2 Nov. → watch: crypto, cyber, korea
## Other Alerts - Global food prices [food-prices] stable: FAO food price index 136.0 in September, above the 135 Alert line - Sahel insurgency [sahel] stable, AI-judged: JNIM blockade of Mali's capital continues to choke supply routes - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable: UK national threat level Severe: an attack is highly likely
## Changed in last 24h - Gold (fear gauge) [gold]: NORMAL→WATCH — Gold near $3,950, down 8.2% over three months, past the Watch line (2026-11-02T23:43Z) - US equity stress [equity-stress]: NORMAL→WATCH — VIX above 20 at a three-month high as tech sell-off extends; S&P 500 3.5% off its high (2026-11-02T23:43Z)
